title: Leg2 re-deposit silently haircuts each user's principal by ~0.026% (DOLA) / ~0.016% (USDC); intent doc states principal is preserved 1:1
description: migrator2.migrate -> depositFor -> _routeDeposit deposits each migrating user's snapshot credit into the FIXED V2 ERC4626YieldStrategy, which (per story-060's own fix) credits convertToAssets(sharesReceived) rather than the nominal amount. The integer-rounding shortfall (received - credited) stays protocol-owned in the strategy, so each user's withdrawable principal on the original staker is strictly less than what they held on the temp staker. Measured on-fork: every DOLA position lost ~0.0260-0.0262% and every USDC position lost ~0.0157-0.0158%. The story-060 intent doc (User Impact) discloses the OLD-strategy (R,P) haircut but NOT this fresh re-deposit haircut introduced by the leg2 deposit into the new strategy.
impact: Real, permanent per-user principal reduction (small, uniform, proportional). Not a 1:1 round-trip as documented. Because tempStaker holds principal idle (no strategy), leg1's deposit was lossless, so this is a SINGLE fresh ERC4626 haircut, not compounded — but it is undisclosed value leakage from the user's perspective and accrues to the protocol/strategy buffer. NOTE: depends on YS-01 being fixed first (deposits revert until then); the haircut is the post-fix steady-state behavior.

classification.assetImpact: Tiny uniform per-user principal haircut (~0.026% DOLA / ~0.016% USDC) from the conservative convertToAssets rounding on the single fresh leg2 re-deposit; accrues to the protocol/strategy buffer. Measured ~0.27 DOLA / ~0.31 USDC total at current scale.
attackPath: 1. migrator2.migrate -> depositFor -> _routeDeposit credits convertToAssets(sharesReceived) into the V2 strategy.
2. Integer-rounding shortfall stays protocol-owned; each user's withdrawable principal is slightly less than held in temp.
classification.likelihood: Deterministic post-fix steady state (depends on YS-01 being fixed first); not compounded since leg1 was lossless.
classification.assumptions: Haircut is correct conservative accounting; only the intent doc's 1:1-preservation claim is inaccurate.

recommendation: Update the story-060 intent doc User Impact section to disclose that the leg2 re-deposit into the new ERC4626 strategy applies a small (~0.02-0.03%) conservative convertToAssets haircut to each position, distinct from the old-strategy (R,P) socialization. No code change required — the haircut is the correct conservative accounting; only the 1:1-preservation claim is inaccurate.
